source_caption:
🎬 Purple Hearts (2022)

Purple Hearts follows Cassie Salazar, a struggling singer-songwriter dealing with financial difficulties and a serious medical condition, and Luke Morrow, a young Marine facing problems of his own. Despite their completely different personalities and beliefs, the two agree to a marriage of convenience to receive military benefits. What begins as a practical arrangement slowly becomes complicated when unexpected challenges force them to confront their feelings. As Cassie pursues her musical dreams and Luke faces the realities of military life, their relationship develops into an emotional journey filled with love, sacrifice, heartbreak, and second chances.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Drama • Music

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 2m • TV-14

🎥 Director: Elizabeth Allen Rosenbaum

✍️ Writers: Kyle Jarrow & Liz W. Garcia

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix.

source_details.title: Purple Hearts
source_details.synopsis: Purple Hearts is a 2022 American romantic drama film created for Netflix and directed by Elizabeth Allen Rosenbaum. It is based upon the novel of the same name by Tess Wakefield. It stars Sofia Carson and Nicholas Galitzine. The film was released on Netflix on July 29, 2022. It received generally negative reviews from critics.
